source: Traced by hand and by color from USGS NAIP aerial photos (public domain), to fill in what OpenStreetMap doesn't have yet.

unsure.all: Hole order and which holes belong to West rather than South are my best guess: the club's sites give no hole map, the two courses share the grounds, and the lengths only partly fit the card.
unsure.18: Fairly sure: matches the published description of West 18 (dogleg right, water crossing, green with lake on the right and many bunkers), ending by the clubhouse.
unsure.1: Starts at the tees beside the clubhouse; taken as hole 1.
unsure.9: Par 3 to the green just east of the clubhouse; taken as hole 9 because it finishes by the clubhouse.
unsure.3: Not changed: the check says 3 should be a long par 5 bending left, but the west strip from its tee pads to this green is at most about 410 yd and straight, and I found no free corridor of 443-575 yd near the 2nd green and 4th tee; the hole order around here may be wrong.
unsure.11: Tee moved back to the flat east-west tee pad west of the pond's north tip (shared with the 2nd tee area); the line plays over the pond corner to the old fairway. Still about 390 yd, a little under the card's shortest 402, and no tee further back is visible.
unsure.6: Tee moved to the north end of the tee area by the lake; the lake and the 5th green leave no room for the card's longer tees, so it still measures near the short end of the card.
unsure.16: Not changed: the check says 16 should be a short par 3, but every green near the 15th green and 17th tee is already used by a West or South hole, and this corridor's tee sits in the houses; which green is the real 16 is unknown.
unsure.17: Green found; the tee is a guess at the south end of the strip, across the end of a lake.
unsure.12: Tee placed by the road bridge at the east end of the corridor; not clearly visible.
unsure.8: Tee not clearly visible; placed at the south end of the fairway.
unsure.14: Tee not clearly visible; placed at the south end of the west strip.
